copy.headline: The Teresa — the collection's lightest dress, made for long evenings.
copy.description: The Teresa closes the Recall Collection at ₦105,000: the lightest, easiest piece of the five, cut for long evenings and warm rooms. Simple enough to style up, easy enough to live in.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs.
copy.editorialQuote: Light on the body, long on the evening.

fabric.drapeDescription: Light, easy drape with gentle movement
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
